== quote-all
'a b'	a b
'it''s $HOME'	it's $HOME
'say "hi"'	say "hi"
'`touch pwned`'	`touch pwned`
'$(touch pwned)'	$(touch pwned)
'x;touch pwned'	x;touch pwned
'star*'	star*
'~root'	~root
'o’’neil;touch pwned'	o’neil;touch pwned
'“q”'	“q”
back\slash	
a\:b	
C:\Users\me	
a!b	
'ends'''	ends'
'{a,b}'	{a,b}
'a&b|c<d>e'	a&b|c<d>e
'#hash'	#hash
true	
null	
'-foo.bar'	-foo.bar
'--%'	--%
